name: KingField
source:
"Somewhere in the Realms of the Entity," 

"There exists a cozy bonfire."

Dwight Farfield and David King are two survivors caught in the terrifying whims of an unknown creature called the Entity. By chance, luck, or perhaps fate, these two attractive young men have found each other and are willing to explore their feelings, no matter the cost.

[From [url=https://orlando-inlove.itch.io/kingfield-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“在实体领域的某个地方，” 

“有一个舒适的篝火。”

德怀特·法菲尔德和大卫·金是两名幸存者，他们被一种名为“实体”的未知生物的可怕想法所困扰。偶然、幸运，或者也许是命运，这两个有吸引力的年轻人找到了对方，并且愿意不惜一切代价探索他们的感情。

[来自[url=https://orlando-inlove.itch.io/kingfield-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
